CHR_021.name: Stonekin

The HERO STONEKIN has a crack shaped like a smile and a bright-yellow lichen patch on its side
CHR_021.anim_lock: Stonekin - round gray boulder, moss tuft on top, lichen spots, heavy-lidded eyes; hero has smile-shaped crack and yellow lichen patch
CHR_021.proportions: Perfect rounded ovoid; eyes sit in upper third.
CHR_021.movement: Rolls with squash on landing; wobbles to settle; freezes instantly into perfect stillness when looked at.
